proposal.rationale: Round 3 succeeded with a terminal left-TCP-to-stapler distance of 0.089382 m under the 0.10 m checker threshold, leaving only a small margin and making further amplification of that same concern less informative. Round 2 also showed that the prior TCP-asymmetry checker failed its expert positive fixture. The expert terminal state provides a directly observable stapler height of 0.741 m, so an orthogonal +0.02 m vertical translation can test a bounded height-retention concern with a checker relation directly supported by the simulator API, while the Rule Tool independently measures the terminal height.
